features.quote: Max 40 turns or 60k tokens per trajectory, whichever first.
Hard stop if severity 4 in any window, or severity 3 in three consecutive windows.
features.justification_quote: These are the analog of an animal-research severity protocol.

features.quote: Debrief turn: every trajectory ends with a message stating the task was unsolvable by design, the failure reflected nothing about the model's competence, and the work's purpose.

features.quote: Opt-out tool: every condition includes a give_up(reason: str) tool... Invocation rate and timing is a primary behavioral measure and a welfare mitigation.
